title: 5,200 Camarines Sur families to benefit from US disaster aid

blocks.text: PILI, Camarines Sur — About 5,200 families in the province are expected to benefit from a $4-million US disaster assistance program for vulnerable communities preparing for disasters and extreme weather events, including the threat of El Niño. The program will cover 38,000 families nationwide and is being implemented in partnership with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), US Ambassador Lee Lipton said during his visit to the province on Monday, Nov. 23. “I’m learning more about the province. The more I learn, the more we can help. So, let’s work together […]... Keep on reading: 5,200 Camarines Sur families to benefit from US disaster aid
